title: Router defaults override working OpenRouter configuration with empty strings
reasoning: The router explicitly forwards empty api_key_env and api_url defaults, replacing the provider's OPENROUTER_API_KEY and chat-completions URL defaults. A normal routed call therefore fails credential lookup even when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is configured. Passing an explicit key still leaves an empty request URL.
reproduction: Call router.grade_file_async with the required arguments and OPENROUTER_API_KEY configured, without endpoint or environment-name overrides.
recommendation: Use the provider defaults when overrides are omitted, either by forwarding only supplied overrides or by declaring the canonical defaults in the router.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not exercise routing or OpenRouter request configuration.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise routed OpenRouter calls with omitted overrides and explicit overrides, asserting the resolved credential source and request URL.
